# Artur Sogomonyan

> Artur Sogomonyan is an AI Engineer based in Vienna, Austria. This is his public portfolio: applied machine learning, computer vision, 3D geometry and toolpath software for multi-axis manufacturing, LLM and RAG systems, and full-stack product work, plus DIY build notes and sport notes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/): Introduction, selected projects, and entry points to DIY, sport, and the knowledge graph.
- [About](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/about): Experience, education, toolkit, languages, awards, and publication.
- [Projects](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/projects): Case studies across applied AI, computer vision, 3D geometry and toolpaths for multi-axis manufacturing, document intelligence, data products, and the interfaces that make them useful.
- [DIY](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/diy): Build notes: miniature batches, print settings, and workshop experiments.
- [Sport](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/sport): Notes on hiking, boxing, diving, and table tennis.
- [Insights](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/insights): An interactive knowledge graph connecting projects, notes, fields of work, organisations, and shared tools; a chart of how projects flow through fields of work; a self-assessed skills profile; and public GitHub activity plus anonymised totals from private organisation work.
- [FAQ](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq): Short, self-contained answers about background, work, CV, and contact.
- [Contact](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/contact): Email, Telegram, LinkedIn, GitHub, and Medium, plus what to include in a first message.
- [CV (PDF)](https://github.com/PropovedNik007/cv/raw/main/Artur_Sogomonyan_cv_long.pdf): Artur Sogomonyan’s CV as a downloadable PDF.

## FAQ

- [Who is Artur Sogomonyan?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#who-is-artur-sogomonyan): Artur Sogomonyan is an AI Engineer based in Vienna, Austria. His background spans applied machine learning, computer vision, 3D geometry and toolpath software for multi-axis manufacturing, full-stack development, and hands-on making.
- [What does Artur Sogomonyan work on?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#what-does-he-work-on): Artur Sogomonyan works where models meet products: shaping the data, testing the method, building the service, and making the result understandable to the person using it. His work covers applied machine learning, computer vision, 3D geometry and toolpath software for multi-axis manufacturing, LLM and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and full-stack web development.
- [What is Artur Sogomonyan’s education?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#education): Artur Sogomonyan’s education includes an MSc Data Science at Technische Universität Wien (TU Wien, 2022–2026) and a BSc Information Technologies and Telecommunications at Bauman Moscow State Technical University (2014–2020), where his thesis was a 3D-printer failure-detection system based on computer vision. He also attended Deep Learning School (MIPT, 2020–2021) and School of Data Analysis (HSE & Yandex, 2020).
- [Which languages does Artur Sogomonyan speak?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#languages): Artur Sogomonyan speaks English (C1), Russian (C2), Armenian (B2), and German (A2), with levels given on the CEFR scale.
- [What is Artur Sogomonyan’s work experience?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#experience): Artur Sogomonyan currently works at Flexam on software for industrial multi-axis additive manufacturing: 3D segmentation, slicing, toolpath and G-code generation for robot arms and multi-axis machines, and the full-stack slicer product in Go, Rust, Python, and TypeScript. Artur Sogomonyan’s earlier roles include CTO & Data Scientist at susteam, Jan 2023 – Feb 2025; Research Scientist at TU Wien (Rail4Future), Feb – Jul 2024; and Machine Learning Analyst at GLOSAV, Feb – Jul 2021. Before that, he worked on 3D modelling and prototyping as well as frontend and full-stack web development.
- [Which technologies does Artur Sogomonyan use?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#technologies): Artur Sogomonyan’s toolkit covers machine learning & vision (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, OpenCV, YOLO), language & retrieval (NLP, LLMs, RAG, LangChain), software engineering (Python, Go, Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, C++, Node.js, Bun, Svelte, React, three.js, FastAPI, Docker), 3D & manufacturing (3D segmentation, mesh processing, slicing, toolpath generation, G-code, robot arms, multi-axis printing, trimesh), and data & infrastructure (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Linux, nginx, Git, CI/CD).
- [Does Artur Sogomonyan work with LLMs and RAG?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#llm-and-rag): Yes. Artur Sogomonyan built an ESG analytics platform (susteam) that combined OCR with retrieval-augmented language models to automate sustainability reporting, and his AIM Hackathon project, which placed 2nd, used RAG to detect greenwashing in corporate ESG reports.
- [What computer-vision work has Artur Sogomonyan done?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#computer-vision): Artur Sogomonyan worked on real-time computer vision for railway-route and obstacle detection at GLOSAV, and his thesis at Bauman Moscow State Technical University was a 3D-printer failure-detection system based on computer vision.
- [Which projects best show Artur Sogomonyan’s work?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#featured-projects): The featured projects on Artur Sogomonyan’s site are Flexam, susteam, Rail4Future, GLOSAV, and Web development path. Each has its own page with context, approach, and stack.
- [What awards and publications does Artur Sogomonyan have?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#awards-and-publications): Artur Sogomonyan took 2nd place at the AIM Hackathon (hosted by TIMETOACT Group — RAG for greenwashing detection) and 2nd place at the Tourism Technology Hackathon 2023 (tourism knowledge graph with an interactive map). He also has a publication: “Surrogate modelling for railway digital twins” (IEEE, 2024).
- [What kinds of problems is Artur Sogomonyan a good fit for?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#fit): Artur Sogomonyan is most useful on ambiguous work: incomplete data, a model that needs a real product around it, or a prototype that has to become dependable. Typical examples are applied-AI products, computer-vision pipelines, and systems that need both model and interface thinking.
- [Where can I download Artur Sogomonyan’s CV?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#cv-download): Artur Sogomonyan’s CV is available as a PDF at https://github.com/PropovedNik007/cv/raw/main/Artur_Sogomonyan_cv_long.pdf. The About page summarises the same experience, education, skills, and languages.
- [How can I contact Artur Sogomonyan?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#contact): You can reach Artur Sogomonyan by email at arthur.sogomonyan@gmail.com, on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/artur-sogomonyan), on Telegram (t.me/arterrai), or on GitHub (github.com/PropovedNik007); he also writes on Medium (medium.com/@artur.sogomonyan). A useful first message names the outcome you want, the current constraint, and the next decision.
- [What else is on Artur Sogomonyan’s site besides projects?](https://propovednik007.github.io/arterra/faq#what-else-is-here): Besides projects, the site has DIY build notes; sport notes on hiking, boxing, diving, and table tennis; and an Insights page with an interactive knowledge graph that connects the notes, a chart of how projects flow through fields of work, a self-assessed skills profile, and public GitHub activity plus anonymised totals from private organisation work.
